headline: Markets held their breath ahead of the Fed and the biggest after-close earnings slate of the year — SK Hynix confirmed AI hardware demand is acute, but tonight MSFT and GOOGL must confirm the software layer is monetizing it.
AI deal avalanche lifts tech and small-caps; Boeing drags the Dow as markets hold their breath ahead of the Fed and mega-cap earnings gauntlet
Anthropic's IPO filing sparked the AI trade's best day in weeks — but MSFT and GOOGL earnings tonight, plus the Fed Wednesday, will decide whether the bounce becomes a trend.
Tech and oil pulled markets in opposite directions as AI spending anxiety from Meta and Tesla earnings collided with a surging crude-price shock tied to Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia

Tech imploded on Meta's $145B AI bill and Saudi oil strikes; small-caps and the Dow barely flinched — the real verdict arrives Wednesday when the Fed, Microsoft, and Alphabet all report within hours of each other.
